note: Based on the original description of the new species by Sjöstedt (1926) (in German), published as Angulitermes truncatus n. sp. in Termiten aus Accra, which describes the soldier, queen and worker together; the alate is not described. Most figures in the original measurements are damaged in the OCR (e.g. Länge 2,6, Kopf mit Mandibeln 1,4..—,14), so only the confirmable values are entered and the damaged places are not guessed at. Type locality Accra, Ghana, 1926-06-29, collected by Pomeroy; types in the Imperial Bureau of Entomology (British Museum) and the Stockholm Museum.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head length from the vertex 0.95—1.00 mm, less than in the congeneric A. frontalis (1.35 mm); frontal process short, its anterior end broadly truncate in lateral view (the frontal process of A. frontalis is conical, long and nearly horizontal, projecting far beyond the anterior margin of the head in lateral view). Anterolateral corners slightly projecting.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head reddish yellow, often slightly darker anteriorly, forming a rather short rectangle (length:width = 27—29:21), the sides parallel, the posterior margin distinctly arcuate, the anterior corners slightly tuberculate; frons broad in dorsal view, narrowing anteriorly, rising slightly and gradually forwards in lateral view, the anterior margin of the frontal process truncate, its height about equal to half the height of the middle of the head; the frontal process about as long in lateral view as two basal antennal segments; a hairy fontanelle depression at the base of the frontal process. Mandibles slender, rod-like, slightly laterally compressed, curved downwards in lateral view, straighter in dorsal view, the tips incurved, slender and slightly hook-like. Labrum of equal width or narrowing slightly towards the apex, the anterior margin distinctly arcuately concave, the two corners acute. Antennae 14-segmented, reddish yellow; basal segment not especially thick, smooth, twice as long as segment 2; segment 2 almost equal in length to the two following segments together; segments 3 and 4 about equal in length, segment 4 slightly shorter and the shortest; the segments gradually longer towards the apex, the terminal segment longest. Lateral margins of the head band-like, very slightly lens-shaped narrowed, equal in width to the adjacent sides of the head. Body and thorax white, the anterior lobe of the pronotum broadly arcuate, entire.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Measurements: soldier body length 2.6 mm, head with mandibles 1.4 mm, head from the vertex 0.95—1.00 mm, mandibles 0.5 mm (most figures in this line are damaged in the OCR of the original; only the legible values are entered). Queen: abdomen white, very finely and densely dotted with sparse dark punctures; head dark brown, with a long pale fontanelle, oval, narrowing anteriorly; labrum (epistom) paler, rather large; antennae with 13 segments remaining, the basal segment rather thick, twice as long as segment 2, segment 2 shorter than the two following segments together, segment 3 the smallest, segments 4 and 5 equal in size, rather globose, the following segments gradually larger outwards; eyes small, round, 0.1 mm wide; ocelli oval, about half their short diameter from the eye; pronotum semicircular, the anterior lobe very small, slightly narrower than the head width between the tips of the two eyes (20:21); mesonotum and metanotum strongly narrowing posteriorly, ending in a short angular notch; body length 12 mm, abdomen 10.5 mm. Worker: body narrow, white, the gut contents dark; head oval, frons flat; antennae 14-segmented, the basal segment as long as the two following segments together, segment 2 as long as the two following segments together and narrowing towards the apex, segments 3 and 4 equal in size, the following segments gradually larger, the terminal segment largest, oval and narrowed; body length 3.5 mm, head width 0.6 mm.
